headline: Ann Blyth, Oscar-Nominated ‘Mildred Pierce’ Actress, Dies at 98
context: She was just 17 when she played Joan Crawford’s ungrateful daughter in the classic 1945 melodrama. It was the high point of a robust but short film career.

sources.name: The New York Times
